summary: verdaccio-tarball-local-storage ships install-time Bun dropper executing obfuscated payload
details: The package declares a `preinstall` hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases into a temp directory, marks it executable, and immediately runs it against the sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~728KB single-line Bun-CJS bundle with string-array-shuffle obfuscation (integer constant table, rotating index function `WV8StW`, mangled identifiers) and has no relation to the package's stated purpose. Using an alternate language runtime to execute the payload bypasses Node-based inspection: the bytes that actually run at install time are the obfuscated Bun bundle, not any Node source visible to typical scanners. The package name and description reference the legitimate `@verdaccio/local-storage` plugin, but `repository.url` points at an unrelated org (`github.com/servicetitan/uikit`) and no verdaccio-plugin functionality is shipped beyond a small stub `dist/index.js`. The name/description/repository mismatch combined with the install-time obfuscated-payload execution is a typosquat-with-payload shape.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
